description: Step 2: Teach it the business. Crawl the business website now and draft a knowledge profile (hours, services, FAQs...). Set apply=true to save it, or review and use put/patch. Reuse an idempotencyKey when retrying; without one, each call executes again.

businessId.description: Defaults to the business of the API key in the Authorization header.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Retries of the same call should reuse it (the stored result comes back); a new value deliberately repeats an identical call. The MCP POST's Idempotency-Key header takes precedence.

name: ringkit_import_knowledge
title: Import website now
